title: Möb Homogeneous Analytic Hilbert Modules over the Bidisc
summary: An analytic Hilbert module $\mathcal{H}$ over the polynomial ring, consisting of holomorphic functions over the bidisc, is said to be Möb-homogeneous if the corresponding pair of multiplication operators is homogeneous with respect to the diagonal action of the group $\{(\varphi,\varphi): \varphi \in \mbox{Möb}\} \cong \mbox{Möb}$. In this article, we construct three families of mutually unitarily inequivalent Möb-homogeneous analytic Hilbert modules, distinct from the family of weighted Bergman modules over the bidisc.
